items.title: Microsoft releases Mage-VL-Cowork: a 4B computer-use model that mixes GUI clicks and terminal commands, 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified
items.summary: Open weights (Apache 2.0) for a 4B vision-language policy trained to choose between clicking through a GUI and running code or shell commands, built on Mage-VL. The release includes the full training recipe, code and a technical report; Microsoft reports 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified, which makes a capable local computer-use agent small enough for a laptop GPU.

doubt.pushback: Score is self-reported in the model card and report; no third-party reproduction yet.

items.title: Unsloth Dynamic v3.1 GGUFs for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, with a full quant benchmark and a reproducibility dispute with GSQ-RCO
items.summary: New dynamic 1 to 4 bit GGUF quants of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, benchmarked across AIME25 (16 runs per question), HMMT 2026, GPQA Diamond, MMLU-Pro, LiveCodeBench v6, Aider Polyglot and IFEval, with reasoning length tracked per quant. Unsloth says it cannot reproduce a rival GSQ-RCO quant's figures (1-bit AIME25 measured at 91.88%, not 100%) and publishes its full method and data.

doubt.pushback: Repliers point out that Unsloth's own table lists 128 to 145 GB for the 1-bit quant even with Engram offloaded to SSD and 233 GB on disk for the smallest file, so the headline '64GB+ RAM' needs heavy offload and likely costs speed or context; others note 2-bit to 1-bit costs about 18% on Aider and that runs used a low effort setting.

reception.summary: Builders welcome the published method and per-benchmark data and plan to run it, but several question the 64 GB RAM headline against the size table, ask for per-quant variance, and note the bigger coding drop at 1-bit; a few say KLD alone is a poor proxy, in line with Unsloth's argument.

items.title: Nace.AI open-sources Drex-Max v1, a 27B decision model that scores options in one forward pass and runs locally on Apple Silicon
items.summary: Weights for Drex Max, a dense 27B model with a 255-way readout head: given a context (text, JSON or images) and named questions, it returns a probability for every option in a single forward pass instead of generating text, useful as a fast classifier or router inside agents. Ships with a Q8_0 GGUF (48 GB), an affine Q4 for Apple Silicon Macs with 24 GB or more, and llama.cpp and Ollama forks; Nace reports 64 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index.

items.title: LeRobot adds interactive prompting: send a new instruction to a running robot policy and it changes course without a reset
items.summary: lerobot-rollout gains an --interactive mode that lets you type a new task instruction while a language-conditioned policy is mid-motion, and the robot switches behavior without stopping the episode; it also works with steerable multi-task policies. Explained in a new Hugging Face blog post, Prompting Robots with LeRobot.
